text:
marie.procure: quick heads-up — vendor flagged a slip on the H100 split shipment to FRA, manifest rework + customs queue. we have 20 units inbound (12 sea / 8 air). thinking options: air-rescue some units or accept sea delay. need vendor ETA and RMA routing for potential DOA returns. AWB: AWB123456789DE
ola.vendor: apologies — we saw an OCI hold on the manifest in FRA. sea leg now ~18 days. we can air-rescue up to 6 units earliest mon (extra cost). for DOA flow: depot can accept and RMA to our EU repair center (5-7d handoff) or return-to-supplier (10-14d).
sanjay.ops: can we prioritize capacity for inference pools? if we lose >=8 H100s to the delay we'll hit capacity in eu-west-1 for next two weeks. need decision by EOD.
luke-logistics: @marie.procure what are the cost deltas for air-rescue vs overnight spare allocation from our US pool? also any insurance recovery for manifest rework?
ola.vendor: ballpark numbers: air-rescue per unit +$4.2k (door-to-door), insurance claim depends on cause code — if it's customs paperwork we can push a broker credit but not guarantee. US-to-EU spare move estimate +$6.5k per unit and 2-3 day transit after prioritization.
marie.procure: ok — summarize options for leadership: A) air-rescue 6 units from current shipment (pay vendor air uplift) — immediate capacity relief, cost ~6*$4.2k = $25.2k. B) reassign 6 units from US spare pool (higher transit cost + internal transfer paperwork) ~6*$6.5k = $39k. C) accept sea delay, ramp down noncritical jobs and enable inference fallbacks — no immediate cash spend but potential SLA risk. please +1/-1 vote.
tim-ship: +1 for A (air-rescue). we have a couple of canary clusters that are sensitive to latency. moving from US introduces more network egress complexity.
lucy-sre: -1 for C. fallback is ok for background batch but will break a client demo on thursday. ops time to mitigate >3d.
sanjay.ops: +1 for A but ask vendor to absorb broker fee if manifest error was on their side.
ola.vendor: we can absorb the broker fee up to €2k if paperwork error can be shown; otherwise we need to bill for customs handling.
marie.procure: action then — proceed with air-rescue for 6 units, vendor to confirm AWB and pickup window. @luke-logistics please prepare inbound temporary change notice and update Dedicated pool scaling rules.
luke-logistics: on it. creating TCN now and tagging route for eu-west-1 pool. estimated arrival mon 09:30 CET.
deput-bot: depot acceptance checklist: 1) crate integrity photos required 2) power-on smoke test 3) serials logged to manifest. failure -> RMA hold.
lucy-sre: can depot run the quick thermal health check on arrival? previous batch had two units with thermal deltas after transit. add to checklist please.
marie.procure: added: thermal gauge check + crate humidity reading. ola, please confirm packaging spec for air uplift to reduce thermal risk.
ola.vendor: will ship in thermal-lined crates and include humidity packs. AWB for the rescue request: AWB-AIR-987654321. greenlighted for Monday if we get confirmation by 17:00 CET.
sanjay.ops: can finance pre-approve the extra spend? @marie.procure want to loop in @finance.
marie.procure: pinging finance separately — we have credits in Q2 surge budget but need explicit sign-off. if finance stalls, fallback is to pull from US spare pool.
marie.procure: final note — if any DOA on the rescue batch, depot will follow RMA->vendor-eu-repair path (5-7d). if sea batch produces DOA later, we'll escalate to return-to-supplier for larger replacements. will post final receipts and AWB once vendor confirms. :white_check_mark:
